# watchpoint_cost_allocation_settings (Resource)

The tenant's stored cost-allocation showback convention, which every showback report and CSV export is produced under. A per-tenant singleton: declare it at most once, alongside the `watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag` mappings it governs. Destroying it leaves the stored convention in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Whether the showback report spreads the shared part of the bill across the
# tag values, or reports it in its own row. Per tenant, so declare it once
# alongside the watchpoint_cost_allocation_tag mappings it governs.
resource "watchpoint_cost_allocation_settings" "example" {
  allocate_shared_cost = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allocate_shared_cost` (Boolean) Whether shared cost is apportioned across tag values. `true` spreads the subscription fee and any spend the usage records do not explain across each tag value in proportion to its metered spend, so every value carries a share of the platform bill. `false` reports that spend in its own explicit row and leaves the tagged values showing metered cost only. Required: the API rejects an omitted value, so there is no "leave as it is" setting to express.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant ID, which is what this per-tenant setting is keyed on.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Per-tenant singleton, so the import ID is the tenant ID.
terraform import watchpoint_cost_allocation_settings.example tnt_001
```
